text:
nina: Publish pipeline failed when releasing sdk-node after typegen regen. Two failures surfaced: registry 401 during npm publish and semver-check blocking due to API diff. Opening thread to coordinate quick fixes.

nina: ```
$ yarn release:sdk --target node
> typegen -> regenerated for openapi v1.43.0, changed export ordering for models
> build -> ok
> npm publish packages/sdk-node --access public
npm ERR! code E401
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/@redwood-inference/sdk-node - must authenticate
Publish aborted: semver-check failed: detected incompatible diff; missing changelog fragment for minor bump.
```

ci-bot: pipeline=publish-sdk job=5021 failed (step=publish): reason="401 & semver-guard" :robot_face:

alex: quick question 11 are we sure the typegen introduced a real API change or just a reorder of exports? The semver tool is pretty sensitive.

nina: it looks like a reorder and a rename of an internal helper symbol, not an external contract change. However our dist-differ flags it as a 'non-trivial' change since file hashes differ.

toni: for the auth side, logs show token was valid at job start but rotated by another workflow mid-publish. The publish step does fixed retries with 2s interval; registry likely rate-limited and the token rotation caused a 401 on final attempt. Need better retry + token refresh hook.

sam: short-term we can re-run with a fresh CI token. Long-term: modify publish action to use exponential backoff (jitter) and to re-fetch tokens from vault on each retry. I'll draft a patch.

kai: regarding semver guard, we could either (A) add a small changelog fragment explaining the non-breaking re-order, or (B) teach the semver diff tool to treat typegen-only reorder as benign. Option A is fastest.

alex: agree, add a fragment and re-run to unblock. But we should schedule the typegen-normalizer work so this doesn't keep happening when OpenAPI changes optional fields. Filing ticket INF-742.

nina: I added a fragment at scripts/changelog/fragments/sdk-node-reorder.md and retriggered pipeline (job #5022).

ci-bot: job #5022 queued by nina.

sam: created PR patch for publish action: https://git.internal/pr/5801 1 uses our retry util with exponential backoff up to 6 attempts and a token-refresh callback. Assigning to alex for review.

alex: reviewing now, small nit about the token-refresh timeout. I'll approve once adjusted.

ci-bot: job #5022 started, step=publish -> npm publish invoked

nina: publish still hit a transient 401 on attempt 2 but retry succeeded after backoff, and semver fragment satisfied the checker. package published as @redwood-inference/sdk-node@0.12.2.

sam: merged PR #5801 into main. Release pipeline will pick up the retry behaviour next run. I also added a unit test that simulates token rotation and asserts our publish step retries + refreshes properly. PR: https://git.internal/pr/5809

kai: I ran a quick staging smoke with sampleapp onboarding; it no longer gets stuck on 401 loops. Filed follow-up to add a sampleapp e2e that simulates delayed registry auth failures (INF-743).

alex: for the mid-term, INF-742 (typegen-normalizer) aims to canonicalize generated exports before diffing. RFC INF-RFC-27 drafted. @toni can you & @sam review?

nina: closing notes: job #5022 published successfully, PR #5801 merged, INF-742/INF-743 created. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll pick up RFC review today.

nina: tagging: @alex (merge review), @toni (RFC), @kai (sampleapp e2e).
